newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Jan-Oct Turkmen oil output 3.2 mln T, below target.
newsitem.headline: Jan-Oct Turkmen oil output 3.2 mln T, below target.

text.p: Turkmenistan's oil production for the first 10 months of this year totalled 3.2 million tonnes, a rise of 0.3 percent over the same period in 1995, Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov said.

Speaking at a meeting of the country's cabinet of ministers broadcast on state television late on Wednesday, Niyazov said that the figure was two million tonnes below the government's production target for all of 1996.
"When 2,000 oil wells are standing idle, it is difficult to talk about the sector's profitability," said Niyazov.
"The sector is not bringing the state a kopeck," he said.
The desert nation bordering Iran and the Caspian Sea produced about 3.5 million tonnes (around 70,000 barrels per day) of oil in 1995.
It boasts some of the largest natural gas reserves in the world but production in that sector has also declined.
